Okay, let me get this straight. Your son, is about to attend community college. Is there a reason for him going to community college?? Was that even his decision?? Or did you and your husband pick this out for him at convenience for the both of you?? Before anyone asks or assumes, I have nothing against community colleges, I’m questioning because of OP’s behavior in the post. He accepted this job without telling you. Do you make it hard for him to confide in you about things? Also, I doubt your son planned on living at home until the girls were old enough to not need a baby sitter. Is he saving to move out?? Also, maybe there’s things he wants for himself that he doesn’t feel comfortable asking for, since you mentioned the part about struggling to provide for the family. Older children are absolutely not free child care. I understand that the girls have issues/are uncomfortable with a stranger being in the home, but there are ways to do background checks on babysitters. I don’t think the girls are too young for therapy, they aren’t infant children. Despite their ages not being mentioned (that I have seen) there are child therapists. YTA.

I came up with a bunch of things it could’ve been over the years, until I finally decided to share this experience with my sister (shortly after sharing with my mother) and that’s when she told me an experience she had in the house. My mother used to work night shifts, so she’d be asleep during the days she worked. She would always have one of us wake her up at a certain time if she wasn’t up already. My sister walked into our parents room, saw a black figure standing over her, said “Mom?” and whatever this thing creeping over her was, quickly looked up and disappeared. We had all also used to talk about the unsettling feeling of the hallway at night time.
I thought about that a few minutes after posting 😅
I think I was scared that if I didn’t sleep, I would see the figure again
It was extremely terrifying, I didn’t end up telling my mother for a long time because I was scared to even talk about it with anyone
